# Schnellecke Logistics USA

Schnellecke Logistics USA is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Schnellecke Logistics provides customized logistics solutions for various industries, including warehousing, in plant logistics, packaging, transport, and digital visibility. Schnellecke Logistics USA employs 358 people (+27.0% YoY, +76 people), founded in 1939. Headquartered in Chattanooga, Tennessee, United States, with offices in Chillicothe, Vance, Woodstock, Huntsville, and Charleston. Its workforce is distributed across United States, South Africa, and India.

## About

The Schnellecke Group is an internationally operating family-owned company that offers a variety of logistics services. One of the major focuses of these activities is value-added logistics for the automotive industry.

We develop complete concepts that range from transportation and warehousing, to pre-assemblies and value-added services, to sequential production of individual parts and modules, and packaging suitable for containers. Furthermore, we produce individual car body parts and car body modules for vehicle manufacturing under the KWD Automotive umbrella brand.

# Schnellecke Logistics

Schnellecke Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Schnellecke Logistics provides customized logistics solutions for various industries, including warehousing, in plant logistics, packaging, transport, and digital visibility. Schnellecke Logistics employs 1,970 people (+60.7% YoY, +744 people). Headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across 15 countries (including Germany, United States, South Africa, Mexico, and Poland).

## About

Schnellecke Logistics is an international supply chain partner that designs, manages and operates complex logistics solutions across industrial value chains - combining operational excellence with the engineering, technology and infrastructure capabilities of the Schnellecke Group.

Our solutions span warehousing and inventory management, manufacturing and in-plant logistics, assembly and manufacturing support, packaging and container management, distribution and transport, as well as aftermarket and reverse logistics.

We support customers in Automotive, Industrial Manufacturing, Technology, FMCG, and Aerospace & Defense.

With a global network and deep operational expertise, Schnellecke Logistics turns logistics complexity into reliable, scalable performance.

  > Schnellecke Group secures € 140 million in long-term financing
  >
  > Schnellecke Group has successfully completed the refinancing of syndicated credit facilities for its two subgroups, Schnellecke Logistics SE and KWD Automotive AG & Co. KG. Together with its financial advisor, FCF Fox Corporate Finance GmbH, the Group developed and implemented a long-term financing structure tailored to the requirements of both businesses. The new financing comprises two syndicated facilities of € 70 million each, bringing the total financing volume to € 140 million.
  >
  > The refinancing provides both subgroups with a stable, long-term financing framework and additional flexibility to support their future development. The transaction also reflects the continued support of Schnellecke Group’s banking partners and establishes a solid financial basis for the subgroups going forward.
  >
  > FCF Fox Corporate Finance acted as exclusive financing advisor to Schnellecke Group throughout the transaction, supporting the process from structuring and bank outreach through negotiations, documentation and closing. properties.name: Schnellecke Logistics
properties.description:
Schnellecke Logistics is an international supply chain partner that designs, manages and operates complex logistics solutions across industrial value chains - combining operational excellence with the engineering, technology and infrastructure capabilities of the Schnellecke Group.

Our solutions span warehousing and inventory management, manufacturing and in-plant logistics, assembly and manufacturing support, packaging and container management, distribution and transport, as well as aftermarket and reverse logistics.

We support customers in Automotive, Industrial Manufacturing, Technology, FMCG, and Aerospace & Defense.

With a global network and deep operational expertise, Schnellecke Logistics turns logistics complexity into reliable, scalable performance.
